Casey (PM): Quick idea: run a 10-company micro-beta focused on timeboxed deep-dive sessions rather than open access. goal = high-signal qualitative + small, automated eval set. thoughts?
Harper (Research): Love it. Recommend 3x 90min deep-dive sessions per partner over 2 weeks + a short automated smoke each morning. That gives us both human color and frequent automated checks.
Iris (Design): We'll build a one-page playbook for partners: session agenda, what to log, how to capture examples. Keep onboarding to 15 minutes.
Moe (Eng): Ops constraints: reserve 4 concurrent slots, isolated feature-flag, and a quick revert tag. prefer canary with 2 partners first 24h.
Sam (Ops): I'll prepare standby pool and invite CSV. also add a consent line with granular telemetry opt-in (logs-only vs full transcripts).
Casey (PM): Acceptance criteria proposal: 1) auto-eval delta <8% on core quality bundle, 2) no P1s, 3) >=70% partners submit at least 2 deep-dive artifacts. If any one fails -> hold; two or more -> rollback.
Harper (Research): Evaluation rubric: automated smoke (5 deterministic prompts), rapid human score (3-point ease/accuracy scale) per deep-dive, and a post-run 6-question survey. I'll produce thresholds and a small scoring dashboard.
Iris (Design): Compensation tiers: $150 credit after onboarding tasks, $300 after completing both deep-dives. I'll draft friendly copy and an FAQ.
Moe (Eng): Runbook snippet for reserve/rollback:```bash
# reserve pool
redwood infra reserve --pool microbeta --gpus 4 --until 2025-01-15
# rollback
redwood deploy rollback --env microbeta --tag stable --reason "microbeta rollback"
```
NotifyBot: Canary policy registered: 20% -> 60% -> 100% with auto-hold wired to eval-delta and structured-output-fail counter.
Casey (PM): Owners: Harper = rubric + dashboard, Iris = comms + FAQ, Moe = infra/runbook + feature-flag, Sam = invites/CSV & consent. Kickoff Wed 11am PT. I'll assemble a tiny playbook we can reuse.
Harper (Research): Will share the eval bundle by Tue.
Iris (Design): Drafting partner note now.
Moe (Eng): Posting runbook snippet in #runbooks once reserved.
Sam (Ops): CSV + invite copy by Tue EOD.
Casey (PM): Nice. Aim for low-friction, high-signal run and repeatable artifacts. :white_check_mark:
